# Super Malaab (سوبر ملعب)

> Super Malaab — سوبر ملعب — is an Egyptian sports app and website at https://supermalaab.com. Players book football
> (5, 7 and 11-a-side) and padel pitches in Egypt online, find players for a match, follow Egyptian and English league
> matches, play Premier League fantasy football and shop for sports gear. Pitch owners and store owners manage their
> bookings, products and payouts from their own dashboards.

Also known as: سوبر ملعب, Supermalaab, SuperMalaab, Super Malaab.
Country: Egypt. Languages: Arabic and English. Currency: EGP.

## How booking works
- Pick a pitch, a date and an hour; see the live free hours and the price per hour.
- Each venue chooses how players pay: a deposit in the app (at least 100 EGP) and the rest in cash at the pitch, or the full amount online.
- Show the booking QR code at the pitch to check in.
- Cancellation and refunds follow each pitch's cancellation policy (see the help center).
